reason: The control-boundary role (same 0.0.0 baseline as 003/004/005/006; this declaration advances the sealed candidate, so the cumulative delta stays MAJOR). Three published token names are ADDED and no name is renamed or removed; every other change is a deliberate effective-value change to already-published leaves. (1) New semantic role ki.outline.control (--ki-outline-control) and its hover step ki.outline.control-hover. A control that can be EMPTY - field, checkbox, radio, switch - carries no label inside its own box, so the box is the only thing identifying it and must clear WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 against every surface it can sit on. No existing outline token could serve: the whole --ki-outline-* family tops out at 1.33:1, and gray-600 #8c929c (3.13:1 on s0) falls to 2.66:1 on s3. The role therefore aliases black/white 48%, measured at 3.59-3.70:1 light and 4.68-5.01:1 dark across s0-s2, and is pinned to that accessibility floor rather than to a position in the emphasis ramp. MarsUI draws Outline/Black-8 in these frames, but as a bevel over a filled cell on a fixed #ffffff canvas; transcribed literally it shipped --ki-input-rest-border at 1.19:1 against a fill identical to the page. This is a declared deviation under the derivation law, not a transcription. material3 pins its own values (M3 md.sys.color.outline, neutral-variant 50/60) so the theme does not inherit the onmars wash. (2) New semantic role ki.surface.primary-med-em-hover (--ki-surface-primary-med-em-hover): brand 600 light, brand 400 dark. Selection controls whose resting fill is the MarsUI default brand surface (brand 500) had no hover that is a real delta in both schemes, because surface.primary-high-em collapses onto surface.primary-med-em in dark. (3) Effective-value changes repointing the empty-box controls onto those roles: ki-input, ki-textarea and ki-select rest/hover/readonly borders; ki-radio unselected rest border; ki-switch unchecked rest/hover/active borders; ki-checkbox unchecked rest border. (4) The brand ramp offset corrected on the selection family: ki-checkbox checked and indeterminate fills move from ki.surface.primary-high-em (brand 600) to ki.surface.primary-med-em (brand 500), the value the MarsUI master binds, and their hover onto the new primary-med-em-hover; ki-switch checked hover and active tracks move onto the same hover role, which also restores the dark-scheme state delta the previous declaration collapsed. In dark the old checked hover fill measured 2.35:1 against the page. (5) The eight component focus-ring descriptions that still recorded MarsUI Focus/primary as a 3px ring at 40% now record 20%, matching the value declaration 006 repointed them to; the 40% came from reading the alpha off the Dark canvas mode.
